escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still with real depth of field, a vast dark studio at night): a Latin American creative director in her mid thirties, dark curly shoulder-length hair, wearing the Efeonce hoodie exactly as in its reference, stands slightly RIGHT of center in the lower part of the frame, framed from the waist up, her head almost frontal, looking straight into the lens with a knowing, amused half-smile. Her LEFT arm, fully visible from shoulder to hand, hangs relaxed and holds a half-used roll of matte black gaffer tape at hip height; her right hand rests in the pocket of her hoodie. Behind her and to the LEFT stands ONE large frameless screen of a fictitious brand campaign, and in its lower corner, where the logo would sit, a wide strip of matte black gaffer tape covers the logo completely. And yet the brand is everywhere: a single hard, low, vivid orange (#FF6500) light from the far left of the frame, at knee to chest height, shines through a large hand-cut stencil of the brand's signature shape — one bold sweeping brushstroke — and PROJECTS that brushstroke shape as sharp-edged orange light across the dark concrete wall behind her and across her hoodie and shoulder, its edges crisp, the rest of the frame in deep shadow. The projected brushstroke is the brightest element of the frame and the only key light on her: warm orange on her left cheek and shoulder, the right side of her face in shadow with the nose shadow legible, NO fill light. A cool azure (#0375DB) rim light from behind outlines her hair. Thin haze makes the beam visible between the stencil and the wall. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm at f/2, nothing foreshortened, she does not lean toward the lens. Fine dust, real sensor grain, genuine depth of field. GEOGRAPHY: the beam and the projected shape stay below 34% of the frame height; the TOP 30% of the frame is calm, deep dark studio space with only faint haze, no beam, no projected light, no screen, no objects. Enormous contrast, deep navy blacks. No readable text, no letters, no logos of any brand anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the near-black matte edge of a long work table close to the lens across the whole bottom of the frame, completely out of focus, outside every light and every reflection

texto.muro: calm, deep dark studio space with only faint haze
